source.title: Graphite under pressure: Equation of state and first-order Raman modes
source.authors: M. Hanfland, H. Beister, K. Syassen
source.license_or_terms: APS copyrighted article, accessible public endpoint. Numeric facts transcribed for research with citation; no permission to redistribute full article asserted. Raw PDF and renderings remain local-only.
source.preprocessing: Manual numeric transcription, visually checked PDF Tables I and II. No curve digitization, refit, smoothing, interpolation or target-curve selection. Parenthesized uncertainties converted to absolute last-digit increments.

material_state.low_mode_caveat: Pressure-cell low-frequency spectra visible only above about 4.5 GPa, with a separate free-standing zero-pressure frequency; delta0 is a fitted zero-pressure derivative, not a direct infinitesimal measurement.
material_state.axial_modulus_caveat: a-axis fit uses fixed beta_prime=1; modulus represents a weak-compression average over the measured pressure range.

uncertainty_policy.propagation: Rectangle sensitivity envelope only, not a statistical confidence interval or an independence assumption.
uncertainty_policy.source_precision_discrepancy: Abstract absolute pressure-slope uncertainties are broader than those implied by Table II logarithmic slopes, especially E2g(2). Preserve both routes and their union sensitivity envelope; do not silently select the tighter table errors.
